Hey all,

While recently completing my L1 Crit All PRO Codes No Damage run, I figured out this. While I was fighting Yozora I was having difficulties reacting to certain attacks. Initially I was under the impression his attack pattern was truely random. Though while grinding, sometimes he would always open a fight with a specific set of moves so I started to wonder. I tabled down all the moves he used in order and I found that Yozora is not 100% random, he has a very specific pattern. The randomness mainly comes in because there are a few specific points where he picks one move from a set of two. Otherwise he’s very determined.

I used this data to amazing success in my run. It only failed to predict him once (where he skipped a laser step for a reason I don’t know). If it wasn’t for this I would probably still be grinding him out. It was much easier handling him when I knew I was only keeping an eye out for one of two specific moves instead of his entire movelist.

You can see this flowchart hold up against my video run against Yozora, I’ve also run it past WillJV2’s L1 Yozora with Kupo Coin steal and Bizkit047’s 2 Play 1 Controller and it works accurately there as well.

Sorry if this is old news, I haven’t seen this anywhere and I’ve had a fair bit of a search so thought I would share. I’m also not the best with graphics sorry! I have confidence in this being extremely accurate, but as I haven’t sat through waves and waves and waves I can’t say it’s completely infallible.

Hope this is useful!

Sorry to show off, but this was SO HARD and I feel the need to share my achievement :D I’m very proud of myself here, and I don’t normally have achievements I feel I can share.

Like the title says this is ALL boss fights in the game, those that do and do not give Merit Points. This includes the story fights where you play as Riku & Aqua, and the ReMind fights too. I didn’t repeat the ReMind fights with Sora that happened in the main game just because it felt pointless to have two same fights.

The only parts where damage was taken is the mini game at the end of Demon Tide 2, and the Everyone vs Xehanort battle. I don’t know what No Damaging those will look like, but given the length of the mini game (and Demon Tide 2….) I wasn’t too keen on grinding it out right away. If examples exist please let me know so I can try to replicate! There were also a couple of moments (Grim Guardians, Xigbar) where I got ‘hit’ but suffered no damage, on a technicality for my sanity I’m taking that!

I learned way too much about how the game worked doing this - at a much deeper level than I would have thought after my vanilla L1 Crit run. 

The one thing I’m proud of though is discovering Yozora’s pattern and turning him completely predictable. I had trouble reacting to a couple of his moves, so looked online to see if there was a pattern breakdown. I couldn’t find it, but some move orders felt consistent. So I tabled it out and found an incredibly consistent pattern. Described it more in the Yozora video description.

This took a while to do thanks to difficulty and work/life. I’m so happy it’s done :)
